label: Regions window itself
summary: The geographical regions window itself, handed to another function.

label: Toggle region
summary: Selects the given region, or deselects it if it was already selected.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a geographical region, in vanilla the list entry itself (`GeographicalRegion.Self`)

summary: The name of the graphics skin, as text.

summary: The list object of the prominent house members, used as the data context of part of the window.

label: Ranked neighbor families
summary: The ranked list of neighboring families, shown in the government administration window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list. Going by its name, the families come in ranked order.

label: Administration window itself
summary: A reference to the government administration window itself, for passing it on to other interface functions.
details: Vanilla does not use it for this type. Going by its name, it hands over the object it is called on. The game documents nothing more.

label: Allows merit pools
summary: Whether merit pools are available in the government administration window.
details: Vanilla uses it to show one set of elements when true and another when false (with `Not`). What a merit pool is, the input does not say.

label: Clear merit pool characters
summary: Empties the character list that is shown for a merit pool.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click. It returns nothing.

label: Close administration window
summary: Closes the government administration window.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click. It returns nothing.

label: Pool type obligations
summary: The list of obligations of the administration pool type, for the window to show.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list. The meaning of the entries comes from the name only.

label: All themes
summary: The list of all themes of the government administration window.
details: Vanilla never uses it. This rests on the name only; the game documents nothing more.

label: Appointment order options
summary: The list of ways the appointment themes can be ordered.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list, next to a sort selection. The reading as sort options comes from the name and the neighbouring sort functions.

label: Appointment sort order
summary: The direction of the appointment sort: a yes or no value that picks between two states.
details: Vanilla feeds it to a helper that turns it into frame 1 or 2 of an icon, so the icon shows the direction. The related sort text shows 'Ascending' or 'Descending' for the other sort order function, so true likely means ascending.

label: Appointment sort selection
summary: The currently selected sort entry for appointments, as a pair of whole numbers.
details: Vanilla uses it as the selected index of a list. It returns a two-number vector (CVector2i).

label: Counties of state rite
summary: Text naming the counties of the state rite, shown in the window.

label: Family groups
summary: The list of family groups the window shows.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list.

label: Figurehead title
summary: The figurehead title of the administration, which can be asked for its holder.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context and also follows it with `.GetHolder` to get the title's holder. The meaning of "figurehead" comes from the name.

label: Figurehead title name
summary: The name of the figurehead title, as text.
details: Vanilla never uses it. Going by its name and the sibling function for the title, it gives that title's name.

label: House power tooltip
summary: The tooltip content that explains the power of the given dynasty house.
details: Vanilla sets it as the data context of a tooltip widget (a value breakdown), passing the house of the list entry. What the tooltip lists comes from the name.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a dynasty house, in vanilla the list entry itself (`DynastyHouse.Self`)

label: Houses with themes
summary: The list of houses that have themes, for the window to show.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list.

label: Investment cap tooltip
summary: The tooltip content that explains an investment cap for the given argument.
details: Vanilla never uses it. This rests on the name only; the game documents nothing more, not even what the argument is.

label: Merit item
summary: A merit item of the window, used as a data context.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of an element. The meaning comes from the name.

label: Merit pool characters
summary: The list of characters of a merit pool, used as a data context.
details: Vanilla sets it as the data context of an element. The meaning comes from the name.

label: Merit pool character window
summary: The window object for a merit pool character, used as a data context.
details: Vanilla sets it as the data context of an element. The meaning comes from the name.

label: Order options
summary: The list of ways the themes can be ordered, for a list or drop-down in the window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list. The reading as sort options comes from the name.

label: Player's house
summary: The house of the player, used as a data context in the window.
details: Vanilla sets it as the data context of an element.

label: Prominent theme groups
summary: The list of prominent theme groups the window shows.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list.

summary: The administration merit pool currently selected in the window.

label: Selected house member
summary: The prominent house member currently selected in the window.

label: Sort order
summary: The direction of the theme sort: a yes or no value that picks ascending or descending.
details: A vanilla tooltip shows 'Ascending' when it is true and 'Descending' when it is false, and a button icon switches its frame by it.

label: Sort selection
summary: The currently selected sort entry, as a pair of whole numbers.
details: Vanilla uses it as the selected index of a list. It returns a two-number vector (CVector2i).

label: Administration title
summary: The title the window is about, used as a data context and for reading the holder.
details: Vanilla sets it as a data context and, in a text, follows it with `.GetHolder` to reach the title's holder's custom text. It returns a title, not text.

label: Unassigned counties
summary: The list of counties not yet assigned in the administration.
details: Vanilla never uses it. This rests on the name only; the game documents nothing more.

label: Is house collapsed
summary: Whether the given house's group is collapsed (folded shut) in the window.

label: Reverse appointment sort
summary: Flips the appointment sort between ascending and descending.

summary: Flips the theme sort between ascending and descending.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click. It returns nothing.

summary: The government administration window itself, handed to another function.

label: Set merit character

fields.text: Not documented; going by the name, a character.

details: Vanilla calls it when the selection of a sort list changes. It returns nothing.

summary: Folds the given house's group shut, or opens it again.

fields.text: The house whose group is switched.

label: Toggle group by house
summary: Switches grouping by house on or off.

label: Government type itself

label: Max piety level

details: Vanilla never uses it. This rests on the name only; the game documents nothing more.

details: Vanilla never uses it. This rests on the name only; the game documents nothing more.

label: Government name, no tooltip

label: Has titles
summary: Whether the window has titles to grant.
details: Vanilla uses it with `Not`, to show something when there are no titles.

label: Default government selected
summary: Whether the 'Default' government choice is the selected one.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the default button as pressed down.

label: Government type selected
summary: Whether the given government type is the selected one.
details: Vanilla uses it to show a government button as pressed down.

label: Government type valid
summary: Whether the given government type may be granted.
details: Vanilla uses it to enable a government button, and to add the tooltip 'Cannot grant this government type' when it is false.

label: Toggle timed filter
summary: Reacts to a click on the timed filter.
details: Vanilla calls it from a click. Going by its name and the checkbox state function, it switches the filter. It returns nothing.

label: Select default government
summary: Selects the 'Default' government choice.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click. It returns nothing.

label: Select government type
summary: Selects the given government type for the grant.
details: Vanilla calls it when a government entry is clicked. It returns nothing.

label: Grant window itself
summary: The grant titles window itself, handed to another function.
details: Vanilla does not use it for this type. Going by its name, and by how other types use their own Self, it passes the object on.
